name: groove
description: One skill for all coding work: it does the task you name, writes the least that finishes it, cuts the rest, and proves it with the cheapest check.

interface.shortDescription: All coding work with the least that finishes it
interface.longDescription: Groove takes coding work from request to report. It does the task you name, plans in one file only for big work and rebuilds, names a caller before writing anything new, cuts what is not needed before finishing, keeps tests to a few seconds, and reports counted numbers.
